purpose: metadata-only census of atom occupancy, alternative support, and exact one-unit cross-atom transfers; no candidate optimization

census_definitions.within_atom_slack: eligible capacity minus selected count in the same exact atom; permits row substitution but not atom-allocation change
census_definitions.cell_only_transfer_potential: selected atom mass and unselected capacity in the same exact joint cell; diagnostic only, ignores input/root/topology/intervention coupling
census_definitions.same_core_cross_atom: different atoms sharing exact model-input digest, root ID, and exact joint cell; a one-unit swap preserves group count, cell count, model-input occurrence count, and root occurrence count
census_definitions.full_profile_one_swap: same-core cross-atom one-unit swap that independently leaves topology and intervention marginal TV at or below 0.02 against the bank's frozen reference; other profile dimensions are invariant under the same-core definition
census_definitions.one_swap_treatment: support witness only; no cumulative treatment-strength or candidate-feasibility claim
census_definitions.supervised_signature_change: at least one selected source signature differs from an available unselected destination signature; excludes bank-level capped invariance-pair context and is not D_train
census_definitions.locked_selected_mass: selected mass in atoms whose eligible capacity equals selected count; describes within-atom substitution only, not cross-atom immobility
census_definitions.gross_transfer_capacity: sum over individually admissible directed atom edges of min(selected source count, destination slack); edges may compete and this is not jointly realizable capacity
